hypotheses.storyTitle: Advancing Financial Mastery for Home Savings
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review current educational progress toward the First Home Savings goal without pressured or timed elements.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer has achieved 63% progress on the First Home Savings Knowledge goal and frequently engages with educational modules.
hypotheses.storyTension: Balancing the desire for deep financial understanding and structured learning milestones against potential distracting gamification.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Engage with clear milestone tracking and goal-linked rewards that validate completed educational modules.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Deepen financial mastery and track structured knowledge milestones toward home savings.

hypotheses.customerResolution: Complete targeted quizzes at a self-determined pace, reinforcing long-term financial mastery.
